name: mellos-mapping
description: 梅勒斯地图 — a live layered dependency map for bottom-up development: ghost the design first, then light nodes up from the bottom as they are built and verified

interface.shortDescription: Live plans beside your ChatGPT desktop Codex conversation
interface.longDescription: For ChatGPT desktop in Codex mode (Codex App). Show layered plans in the current conversation's right terminal and update progress with verification evidence. The installer configures the skill and six local MCP tools. If the host cannot type into its terminal, the assistant provides one exact startup command. Markdown/SVG and interactive web views are also available.
defaultPrompt: 用梅勒斯地图制定当前任务的分层计划，打开当前对话右侧终端展示；若宿主无法输入命令，给我一行可直接运行的命令。
先声明本次功能的设计图，在右侧持续展示实现和验证进度。
